## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix zero-limit handling before merge because it hides all orders when the caller explicitly requests an unlimited listing.

## Changes
The pull request adds `limit` and `offset` to the newest-first order listing, delegates slicing to a pagination helper, and adds tests for both functions.

## Critical

- app/orders.py:9 — correctness — Treat a zero order limit as unlimited — For a nonempty order list, `list_orders(orders, limit=0)` returns `[]` because it forwards zero to `paginate`, which makes the slice stop at its start. Issue fixture/fixture#12 requires “limit=0 means no limit: return every order.” — Callers that request an unlimited listing with `limit=0` see no orders even when the account has orders. — Fix: Convert zero to `None` before calling `paginate` and extend `test_limit_caps_results` to cover zero.
